references.text: Confirms that the Lord is God, and that there is no other besides him – the same theme of acknowledging the Lord as the only God.
The same call to walk in the ways of the Lord, keep his commandments and statutes, and serve him.
Emphasizes keeping the Lord's statutes, commandments, and laws – parallel concepts to the text.
An exhortation to walk in the ways of the Lord and fear him.
The Lord will confirm Israel as his holy people when they keep his commandments and walk in his ways.
Israel shall be the Lord's treasured possession and a holy people – the same covenant context.
The Lord confirms Israel as his people, and he will be their God – the same covenant relationship.
The prophecy that they will call on the name of the Lord, and he will say, 'This is my people' – confirming the covenant relationship.
Believers are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation – the New Testament fulfillment of the identity of God's covenant people.
